answer_1.quote: In the writing subtask, the system is given a question that is guaranteed to contain a false presupposition, and is required to generate the presupposition as well as the correction.

answer_2.quote: We use sacre-BLEU and unigram-F1 following as well as Sent-BERT (Reimers and Gurevych, 2019) for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation of model generations on 200 randomly sampled test instances from the following aspects (each in the 0-3 scale): • Fluency: The generated text should be fluent (i.e., free of grammatical errors, spelling errors, and repetitions). • Presupposition: The generated presupposition should be the valid one in the question, and is factually false. • Correction: The correction should be made in the comment and provide reasonable amount of justification rather than being a simple negation of the presupposition. • Consistency: The presupposition and correction should be on the same topic and negate each other.
answer_4.guideline: The generated text should be fluent, the presupposition should be valid and factually false, the correction should provide justification, and the presupposition and correction should be consistent.
